f3_program: collection("shelter.animals", "animal", "shelter", source("total animals are there in the shelter"))
observe(at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "initial"), 15, "count", source("There are 15 cats in a shelter"))
remove("cat_adoption", "unspecified", at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "current"), fraction(at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "initial"), 1, 3), source("One-third were adopted"))
add("cat_replacement", "unspecified", at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "current"), scale(event_field("cat_adoption", "quantity"), 2), source("were replaced with twice the amount that were adopted"))
add("dog_arrival", "dogs", at("shelter.animals.dogs.count", "current"), scale(at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "current"), 2), source("twice as many dogs showed up as there are cats"))
query("remaining_count", "shelter.animals", "current")
collection("coleen.sprinkle_cans", "can", "coleen", source("twelve cans of sprinkles"))
observe(at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "initial"), 12, "count", source("twelve cans of sprinkles"))
consume("sprinkle_application", "coleen", at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "current"), "coleen.sprinkle_cans.used.count", source("applying sprinkles to her hair, her clothing and her pets"))

offset(at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "current"), fraction(at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "initial"), 1, 2), -3, "count", source("3 less than half as many cans of sprinkles as she started out with"))
query("remaining_count", "coleen.sprinkle_cans", "current")
collection("bowl.candies", "candy", "bowl", source("candies left in a bowl"))
collection("friend.candies", "candy", "friend", source("10 of her candies"))
consume("previous_week_eating", "shelly", at("bowl.candies.count", "current"), 20, source("Shelly ate 20 candies the previous week"))
observe(at("bowl.candies.count", "after_previous_week"), 50, "count", source("50 candies left in a bowl after Shelly ate 20 candies the previous week"))
multiple("friend.brought_candies.count", at("bowl.candies.count", "before_previous_week"), 2, source("bringing twice as much candy as she originally had"))
add("friend_candies_added_to_bowl", "shelly", at("bowl.candies.count", "current"), "friend.brought_candies.count", source("Shelly adds this to the bowl"))
fraction_of(at("shelly.candies.count", "after_division"), at("bowl.candies.count", "before_division"), 1, 2, source("they decide to divide them equally"))
fraction_of(at("friend.candies.count", "after_division"), at("bowl.candies.count", "before_division"), 1, 2, source("they decide to divide them equally"))
consume("friend_eats_candies", "friend", at("friend.candies.count", "current"), 10, source("after eating 10 of her candies"))
query("remaining_count", "friend.candies", "current")
assumptions: In "she originally had," "she" refers to Shelly; the final eater and owner of "her candies" is Shelly's friend.

f3_program: collection("wendi.chickens", "chicken", "wendi.home", source("Wendi brought home 4 chickens"))
add("first_bring_home", "wendi", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), 4, source("Wendi brought home 4 chickens"))
add("second_bring_home", "wendi", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), "wendi.chickens.second_addition.count", source("she brought home enough additional chickens"))
multiple(at("wendi.chickens.count", "after_second_bring_home"), at("wendi.chickens.count", "before_second_bring_home"), 2, source("double the number of chickens she owned"))
consume("dog_eats_chicken", "neighbor.dog", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), 1, source("a neighbor's dog ate one of her chickens"))
offset("wendi.chickens.final_addition.count", 10, -4, "count", source("an additional 4 less than ten chickens"))
add("final_bring_home", "wendi", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), "wendi.chickens.final_addition.count", source("Wendi found an additional 4 less than ten chickens and brought them home too"))
query("remaining_count", "wendi.chickens", "current")
collection("ground.pinecones", "pinecone", "ground", source("pinecones on the ground"))
observe(at("ground.pinecones.count", "initial"), 2000, "count", source("There are 2000 pinecones on the ground"))
consume("reindeer_eating", "reindeer", at("ground.pinecones.count", "current"), fraction(at("ground.pinecones.count", "initial"), 20, 100), source("20% are eaten by reindeer"))
consume("squirrel_eating", "squirrels", at("ground.pinecones.count", "current"), scale(event_field("reindeer_eating", "quantity"), 2), source("Twice as many are eaten by squirrels as reindeer"))

remove("fire_collection", "unspecified", at("ground.pinecones.count", "current"), fraction(at("ground.pinecones.count", "current"), 25, 100), source("25% of the remainder are collected to make fires"))
query("remaining_count", "ground.pinecones", "current")
